one_liner: Watches a live contract's events block by block and turns every log into readable fields — never repeating an alert, even after a restart.
what_it_does: Think of it as a doorbell for a blockchain contract: whenever the contract emits an event, this lamp rings with a readable summary. It scans every block in order and remembers its place, so a restart never causes a duplicate alert. Proven by 6 real transactions on the Atlantic testnet — the contract deploy plus 5 event-emitting calls — all linked below.
